retrievalProfile.description: A multi-character ensemble composition featuring a central figure with magical energy, set against a textured industrial background with a high-contrast logo overlay.

recipe.visualDefinition: A pyramid-shaped character arrangement on a corrugated rooftop, featuring a central standing figure casting a large, stylized shadow against a rusted metal wall, with a glowing green energy effect and a bold, textured logo in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Pyramidal character grouping creates a stable but dynamic focal point
Contrast between the gritty, rusted background and vibrant character costumes
The large shadow behind the central figure acts as a thematic framing device
Glowing green energy provides a secondary light source and focal point
coreInvariants: Corrugated metal texture in the background and foreground
High-contrast lighting with a warm sunset glow on one side
Distressed, beveled typography with metallic textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure is standing and scaled largest; three supporting figures are crouched or sitting in the lower half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red apple-shaped graphic element in the bottom left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central figure's face, moves down to the glowing hand, then sweeps across the seated characters to the logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper corners, showing the sky and the top of the rusted wall.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns and grays of the industrial setting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant purples, blues, and reds of the character costumes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon green for magical effects and gold for typographic highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground subjects against a desaturated, textured background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between subjects and background

letterConstructionRules: Integrated illustrative elements within the initial character
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter is integrated into a large, bitten-apple graphic with a tail-like flourish.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A small, clean sans-serif for secondary metadata placed above the main title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the epic, fantasy tone of the poster.
Provides the necessary authority and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of four young adults in fantasy-punk attire on a corrugated metal roof. The background is a rusted wall with a large, ominous shadow of a horned figure. A sunset sky is visible in the distance.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, beveled gold serif title across the bottom, featuring a stylized red apple icon on the left side.

verificationChecks: Is the central figure casting a large shadow?
Is the typography beveled and metallic?
Is there a glowing green effect in the center?
Is the background texture industrial and rusted?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the green magic glow
Level of rust on the background wall

mustAchieve: Cohesive color grading between characters and environment

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth in the logo
Ensure the shadow matches the central figure's pose
Verify the corrugated texture is consistent
Confirm the sunset lighting affects the character edges
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble cast + Industrial texture + Thematic shadow + Beveled metallic typography
